proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellOverride.restricted_mode_options
proposed_widenings.justification: A granted spell can currently override DC and target restriction, but not narrow the spell's internal cast-time choice space. This item only allows specific Command options.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellOverride.area_shape
proposed_widenings.justification: A granted spell can currently reference an existing spell record, but cannot override that spell's printed area dimensions when an item specifies a different template.

notes: The item chassis fits the existing magic-item activation surface: 7-charge pool, held activation, fixed DC 15, dawn recharge of 1d6+1, and last-charge destruction roll. The blocker is item-scoped overrides on the granted spells, so no Dhall/JSON/trace was authored.
